**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural roads, 45 mph on urban roads.
• 70 mph on interstate highways (except where posted otherwise).
• 65 mph on rural two‑lane highways. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limits page | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child‑safety seat or booster.
• No “seat‑belt law” for drivers over 18, but all passengers must buckle. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited (unless using a hands‑free system).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC 0.02% or higher).
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, possible jail time. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI laws | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at red lights and stop signs.
• “Yield to the right” at uncontrolled intersections. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• No passing on either side of a stopped bus with flashing red lights. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers.
• Keep a safe following distance. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Headlights & Visibility** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during rain, fog, or snow.
• Fog lights only when visibility is less than 200 ft. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Towing a vehicle requires a valid license and registration.
• Tow‑away laws apply to abandoned or unsafe vehicles. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Parking** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or on sidewalks.
• Pay‑and‑display or meter parking in most cities. | City ordinances & TxDOT | | **Vehicle Registration & Insurance** | • Must register within 30 days of moving to Texas.
• Minimum liability insurance required. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles: helmet required for riders under 18.
• Commercial vehicles: additional licensing (CDL) and safety inspections. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | --- ### How to Get the Full Text of the Law 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – The primary source for all traffic laws. *Website:* https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TRAN/htm/TRAN.545.htm 2. **TxDOT Traffic Safety Handbook** – Practical guidance and statistics. *Website:* https://www.txdot.gov/inside-txdot/traffic-safety.html 3. **TxDMV – Driver Handbook** – Covers licensing, registration, and penalties. *Website:* https://www.txdmv.gov/handbooks 4. **Local City Ordinances** – May have additional rules (e.g., parking, speed limits). *Check your city’s official website.* --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always keep a safe following distance** – especially on highways where speeds are higher. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk or text while driving. - **Check for school bus signals** before proceeding through intersections. - **Be mindful of weather** – reduce speed in rain, fog, or snow. - **Know your local speed limits** – they can vary widely between rural and urban areas. --- If you need more specific information (e.g., penalties for a particular offense, how to appeal a ticket, or details about commercial driving regulations), let me know and I can dive deeper!
